Flooded Ruins
A dire snapping turtle guards the 
secrets of explorers who lost their lives 
uncovering the truth of the ziggurat.
Atop an island in the middle of the 
river is a crumbling basalt temple. 
Locals are terrified of the spirits 
that haunt it — the tortured souls of 
explorers who first encountered this 
place. A dire snapping turtle awaits 
hungrily over their remains.

Shune’s Vestments. Purple, arcane 
robes which make the wearer invisible 
to undead. Each day, Shune compels 
the wearer to slay an innocent. If they 
do, they become immune to all harm 
from undead until the next day.
